args:
set -eu
echo "[agent] booting in cluster pod $$"
echo "[agent] JENKINS_AGENT_NAME=$${JENKINS_AGENT_NAME:-k3s-agent-$$(hostname)}"
echo "[agent] jnlp url=$${JENKINS_JNLP_URL}"
echo "[agent] waiting for jenkins controller on wg0..."
for i in $$(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -sS --max-time 2 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$${JENKINS_JNLP_URL}/login" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "200|403"; then
    echo "[agent] controller reachable"
    break
  fi
  echo "[agent] attempt $$i/30..."
  sleep 5
done
echo "[agent] Kubernetes plugin in Jenkins controller is required for live JNLP registration. Once installed + node template created, the controller will dynamically provision JNLP agents via pod templates and skip this static deployment."
sleep infinity
